source.post_text:
🚨JUST IN: Apple $AAPL is expected to unveil the iPhone 18 Pro on September 9, per Forbes.

For traders, the focus will be on upgrade demand, pricing and AI features. 

A strong launch could support Apple’s holiday-quarter revenue and benefit key supplier TSMC, while weak preorders may raise concerns about the upgrade cycle.

replies.text: Pricing and real AI utility will decide if this cycle beats the last one for upgrades.
